author: Colin P. McNally, Wladimir Lyra and Jean-Claude Passy
title: A Well-Posed Kelvin-Helmholtz Instability Test and Comparison
review_scope: Read original sections1–3 on matching smooth finite-domain models and growth diagnostics; arXiv journal metadata checked. Our forced incompressible model is distinct.

review.ja: 原著の滑らかな層・有限領域・成長測定の議論を確認。本例は独自の強制非圧縮系です。
review.en: Selected original methodology read; our incompressible forced inputs differ from its compressible benchmark.

author: Antonio Celani, Andrea Mazzino and Lara Vozella
title: Rayleigh–Taylor turbulence in two dimensions
review_scope: Read original pp1–2 governing equations1–2 and doubly periodic Boussinesq setup. No original turbulent-run reproduction.

review.ja: 原著のBoussinesq方程式と周期設定を確認。本例の滑らかな定常維持二層と線形参照は独自です。
review.en: Original Boussinesq equations and periodic setup read; our smooth maintained layers and linear reference are constructed here.
